title: Derivative of a slice of an integer multiplicity current along a direction
statement: Let P, q, n' ∈ ℕ, let Y ∈ 𝒟_q(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ q) have an integer multiplicity representation R_Y (R_Y.Represents Y), let Φ : Λ^{n'} → Λ^q be a continuous linear map, ω a test n'-form (ω : TestFormOn univ n', underlying form ω̂), s, v ∈ ℝ^P and τ ∈ ℝ. Then the real function σ ↦ currentEval Y (y ↦ Φ(ω̂(s + σ·v + y))) has derivative currentEval Y (y ↦ D[z ↦ Φ(ω̂(z))](s + τ·v + y)[v]) at τ (HasDerivAt), where D = fderiv ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P q n' : ℕ) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) q) (RY : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) q) (Φ : Covector (Euclid P) n' →L[ℝ] Covector (Euclid P) q) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n') (s v : Euclid P) (τ : ℝ), RY.Represents Y → HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => currentEval Y (fun y => Φ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (s + σ • v + y)))) (currentEval Y (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => Φ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') z)) (s + τ • v + y) v)) τ
